en.tagline: Render MP4 videos from React Remotion component code
en.summary: This skill takes React Remotion component code in TSX and renders it to an MP4 video through the inference.sh CLI (`belt`). You set the duration, frame rate, resolution, and optionally props and codec. It helps when you want to make a video from code instead of editing it by hand.
problem: Making an animated video with Remotion usually means setting up a local Remotion project and rendering it yourself. For a short animation or a data-driven clip, that setup is extra work.
With this skill, you send the component code and render settings in one call to `belt app run infsh/remotion-render`. You get back a video file, and you can reuse the same code with different props.
fit: Motion graphics and animated text or shapes written as code
Data-driven videos where props change the content
Animations that use spring, interpolate, or Sequence timing
unfit: Videos that need AI-generated footage (see the ai-video-generation skill instead)
steps: Write a TSX component that default-exports a Remotion component.
Set the render options: duration_seconds, fps, width, height, and optionally codec, composition_id, and props.
Run `belt app run infsh/remotion-render` with the code and options as JSON input.
The service renders the component to an MP4 video.
Read the video URL from the output. The Python SDK returns it as `output["video"]`.

zh.tagline: 用 Remotion 组件代码渲染 MP4 视频
zh.summary: 这个技能接收 TSX 格式的 React Remotion 组件代码，通过 inference.sh CLI（belt）将其渲染为 MP4 视频。你可以设置时长、帧率、分辨率，还可以按需设置 props 和编码格式。当你想用代码生成视频，而不是手动编辑时，它很有用。
problem: 用 Remotion 做动画视频，通常需要搭建本地 Remotion 项目并自行渲染。对于短动画或数据驱动的片段，这些准备工作比较繁琐。
使用这个技能时，你只需通过 `belt app run infsh/remotion-render` 发送一次请求，内容包括组件代码和渲染参数。返回的是视频文件，同一份代码还可以配合不同的 props 重复使用。
fit: 用代码编写的动态图形，例如动画文字或图形
内容由 props 驱动的数据视频
使用 spring、interpolate 或 Sequence 控制时间的动画
unfit: 需要 AI 生成素材的视频（请改用 ai-video-generation 技能）
steps: 先运行一次 `belt login` 登录。
编写一个 TSX 组件，并用 default 导出一个 Remotion 组件。
设置渲染参数：duration_seconds、fps、width、height，还可以按需设置 codec、composition_id 和 props。
用代码和参数作为 JSON 输入，运行 `belt app run infsh/remotion-render`。
服务会把组件渲染成 MP4 视频。
从输出中获取视频地址。使用 Python SDK 时，它位于 `output["video"]`。
